lines.en: My wings are thin as wet paper.
I skim the water, hunting flowers.

lines.zh: 海嗣化以后，还是嗡嗡响。
lines.en: Seaborn-touched, I still buzz.
Droplets hang from my antennae.
I don't gather honey now; something else.
One beat, and the mist scatters.
Salt on my legs.
Seaside flowers get visited too.

lines.zh: 飞得歪，因为翅膀沾了水。
lines.en: I fly crooked; my wings are wet.
I weave around the wave crests.
The hive is no longer mine.
Small body, quick to hide.
I fly and drip.

lines.zh: 岸上的风，把我推来推去。
lines.en: Shore wind shoves me about.
I hunt footholds among the rocks.

lines.zh: 这身壳，越来越不像蜂了。
lines.en: This shell looks less and less like a bee.
I settle on a wet leaf.
Wings folded, still quivering.

lines.zh: 海嗣的气味，我自己都闻得到。
lines.en: Even I can smell the seaborn on me.
I groom my antennae.
No flowers here — only sea.
I hang inside a haze of spray.
A drop lands on my back.
I'm not the bee I was.
My antennae test the air's warmth.
I wait for flowers to reopen.
My buzzing quiets.

lines.zh: 潮声一响，我就竖起翅膀。
lines.en: A wave sound sets my wings up.
An itch — I shake it off.
Too salty here.

lines.zh: 你挡住了我这一侧的光。
lines.en: You're blocking the light on my side.

lines.zh: 我的复眼，看得见你每一动。
lines.en: My compound eyes catch every move.
Are you going to swat me?

lines.zh: 你身上的盐味我记住了。
lines.en: I've learned the salt on you.
No flowers in your hand.
I hover before your eyes.
This seaborn shell — does it frighten you?
I'm no ordinary bee now.
You blink, and I back off a hair.
You hold still, and I stop my wings.
A corner of my wing tore.
The swat sends me spinning.
I hit the ground and roll.
This wound makes flying harder.
A sharp, thin buzz escapes me.
I hide in a rock crevice.

lines.zh: 咸水从我翅根一点点淌下来。
lines.en: Salt water trickles down from the base of my wing.
Water seeps through the tear.
I crawl up onto a leaf.
The pain makes my flight stagger.
Is that a flower, or something else?

lines.zh: 我不采蜜了，可还是会靠近。
lines.en: I don't gather honey, yet I still come.
One whiff of sweetness and I lose focus.
Wave it, and I sway along.
I fear it's a trap.
One circuit, then decide.

lines.zh: 这么甜，不像海里的东西。
lines.en: So sweet — not of the sea.

lines.zh: 我翅膀不自觉就飞过去了。
lines.en: My wings carry me over unbidden.
Don't grab at me.
This once I'll come close and just smell it.

lines.zh: 我这么小，撞上你很吃亏。
lines.en: Tiny as I am, hitting you costs me.
My wings got knocked out of rhythm.

lines.zh: 被弹开，我打着转找回方向。
lines.en: Knocked loose, I spin until I find my line.
A splash soaks me.
Don't swat; one swat and I'm done.
I skim past your shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一下，我掉了两根触须。
lines.en: Two antennae hairs came off.
I retreat toward the stone.
I climb right after the bump.
My buzzing goes ragged.
The queen isn't here.
After the change, the hive scattered.
Only the urge to fly remains.
My kin don't know me.
Who'd come near with this salt on me?
I spend nights alone on the rocks.
My buzzing gets no reply.
Wings remain, but not the way home.

lines.zh: 孤独得连潮声都听见了。
lines.en: Lonely enough to hear the tide.
The tide says the rest for us.
A petal scrap — I hold it.
Bits of kelp I can carry too.
I stick it to my legs.
Dropped in the water; gone.
This will keep me going a while.
I lift off holding it.
Too heavy; I can't lift.
I hook it on a foreleg.
Keep the salt off it.
Once I have it, I fly.
You've entered my watch range.
Both antennae stand straight.
The seaborn instinct wakes.
I hover, square to you.
Not a flower — then a threat.
My wingbeat changes pitch.
I've fixed your position.
Hold still; I've aimed.
Even this small body can strike.
I've learned your breathing.
I circle around you.
The buzzing draws nearer.
I'm looking for an angle.
Your hand rises; I pull back.
I'll come from above.
The mist blurs my sight.
Closer and I fire.
One wingbeat is the signal.
This range is just right.
You can't outrun me.
I dart in with a sting.
A seaborn barb is stranger than venom.
I fly right against you.
That will make you pull your hand back.
Sting, then flee.
A wingbeat spin, then again.
I don't linger; I'm fragile.
Don't swat; you'll miss.

lines.zh: 这具身子太小，只能偷袭。
lines.en: This body is too small for anything but ambush.
The barb slips into a gap in your armor.

lines.zh: 一只湿漉漉的蜂出现了。
lines.en: A sodden bee appears.
I shake the water off my wings.
The sea wind carried me here.
Any flowers here?
The moment I arrive, I buzz.
The seaborn mark remains.

lines.zh: 海嗣的壳，从水雾里钻出来。
lines.en: This seaborn shell pushes out of the spray.
The bright shore makes me squint.
I alight on a rock.
The tide just went out; strong smell.
Fire curls my wings.
I hit the ground and roll twice.
Water wraps me; my wings won't move.
The blast flings me away.
The arrow's wake flips my wings.
That force makes my hover fail.
No flowers; I slow down.
A flash, and I drop.
The air empties; I plummet.
